framework.name: Common Core State Standards — English Language Arts
framework.subject: ELA
framework.description: CCSS ELA Grades 3–5 sample (RL/RI/W slices). Sample depth — expand with full grade bands as needed.

children.title: Ask and answer questions to demonstrate understanding of a text
children.summary: Ask and answer questions to demonstrate understanding of a text, referring explicitly to the text.

objectives.statement: Students answer a text-based question with an explicit citation.

children.title: Describe characters and explain how their actions contribute to events
children.titleKo: 인물과 행동이 사건에 미치는 영향 설명하기
children.summary: Describe characters in a story and explain how their actions contribute to the sequence of events.

objectives.statement: Students describe a character trait tied to an action and event.

children.title: Refer to details and examples when explaining text
children.titleKo: 텍스트를 설명할 때 세부사항과 예시를 인용하기
children.summary: Refer to details and examples in a text when explaining what the text says explicitly and when drawing inferences from the text.

objectives.statement: Students cite specific textual details when explaining explicit meaning and inferences.
objectives.masteryCriteria: In 2 of 3 prompts, student cites a relevant detail for an explicit claim and an inference.

resources.title: Evidence Hunt — RL.4.1
resources.description: Find and label explicit vs inferred evidence (placeholder).

children.title: Determine theme and summarize text
children.summary: Determine a theme of a story, drama, or poem from details in the text; summarize the text.

objectives.statement: Students state a theme supported by details and write a concise summary.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Theme statement + 2 supporting details + summary of ≤5 sentences.

children.title: Describe character, setting, or event using details
children.summary: Describe in depth a character, setting, or event in a story or drama, drawing on specific details in the text.

objectives.statement: Students describe a character/setting/event with specific text details.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Description includes ≥3 text-based details without plot dumping.

children.title: Refer to details and examples when explaining informational text
children.titleKo: 정보 텍스트 설명 시 세부·예시 인용하기
children.summary: Refer to details and examples in a text when explaining what the text says explicitly and when drawing inferences from the text.

objectives.statement: Students cite a detail or example that supports an explicit statement or inference.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Response pairs claim with a text citation for 3 of 3 prompts.

children.title: Determine the main idea and explain how key details support it
children.summary: Determine the main idea of a text and explain how it is supported by key details; summarize the text.

objectives.statement: Students state the main idea and list supporting details in a short summary.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Summary includes main idea + ≥2 supporting details in order.

children.title: Explain events, procedures, ideas, or concepts in a text
children.summary: Explain events, procedures, ideas, or concepts in a historical, scientific, or technical text, including what happened and why, based on specific information in the text.

objectives.statement: Students explain a procedure or concept using specific text information.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Explanation names what/why with ≥2 text-based details.

children.title: Write opinion pieces with reasons and support
children.summary: Write opinion pieces on topics or texts, supporting a point of view with reasons and information.

objectives.statement: Students write an opinion with a clear claim, reasons, and concluding statement.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Opinion piece includes claim, ≥2 reasons with support, and conclusion.

children.title: Write informative/explanatory texts
children.summary: Write informative/explanatory texts to examine a topic and convey ideas and information clearly.

objectives.statement: Students organize an informative text with introduction, facts, and conclusion.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Text has clear topic intro, ≥3 facts/details, and closing.

children.title: Write narratives with descriptive details
children.summary: Write narratives to develop real or imagined experiences or events using effective technique, descriptive details, and clear event sequences.

objectives.statement: Students write a narrative with sequenced events and sensory/descriptive details.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Narrative shows clear sequence and ≥4 descriptive details.

children.title: Quote accurately when explaining and drawing inferences
children.summary: Quote accurately from a text when explaining what the text says explicitly and when drawing inferences.

objectives.statement: Students support an inference with an accurate quotation.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Inference + accurate quote for 3 of 3 prompts.

children.title: Determine two or more main ideas and explain how they are supported
children.titleKo: 둘 이상의 중심 생각과 뒷받침 설명하기
children.summary: Determine two or more main ideas of a text and explain how they are supported by key details.

objectives.statement: Students state ≥2 main ideas with supporting details.

children.title: Write opinion pieces supporting a point of view with reasons and information
children.summary: Write opinion pieces on topics or texts, supporting a point of view with reasons and information.

objectives.statement: Students write an opinion with reasons and a concluding statement.
